thread:
jess_newhire: hi all, day 2 trouble. trying to pull from our internal registry (10.20.5.2:5000) but docker hangs and eventually times out. i can ssh to bastion but registry connections fail. any quick ideas? :confused:

vpn-bot: WireGuard session established for jess_newhire (peer=jess_newhire, wg0).

maddy-eng: can you `curl -v http://10.20.5.2:5000/v2/` and `ip route` + `wg show`? helps narrow whether traffic leaves your wireguard tunnel.

jess_newhire: curl gives "Failed to connect to 10.20.5.2 port 5000: Connection timed out". traceroute stops at 100.64.0.1. ip route shows default via 192.168.0.1, wg0 has allowedips 0.0.0.0/0.

sam-sre: that traceroute hop 100.64.0.1 indicates carrier-grade NAT at the ISP. our registry restricts outbound connections to a small allowlist of company egress IPs, so when your traffic is SNAT'd behind the ISP CGNAT, the source IP is not in our allowlist.

jess_newhire: ugh that makes sense. my ISP router is a managed mesh that uses CGNAT. what's the recommended workaround for people in this situation?

maddy-eng: short-term: port-forward the registry through the bastion so the request originates inside our network. run on your laptop: `ssh -L 5000:10.20.5.2:5000 jess@bastion.redwood.internal -N` then `docker pull localhost:5000/redwood/base:latest`.

jess_newhire: followed those steps and it worked, pulled image fine. thanks! :raised_hands:

sam-sre: ticketing note: we'll add a note to New Hire checklist and create an infra ticket to deploy a TLS proxy for the registry so folks behind CGNAT don't need tunnels. @ola-security please advise on allowlist policy for the short-term.

ola-security: temporary SSH-tunnel workaround is acceptable for onboarding. please add justification to the ticket (onboarding + CGNAT cases). long-term we prefer a proxy or auth-layer rather than expanding egress allowlists.

maddy-eng: FYI if you see flaky wireguard UDP (common with some home routers), try lowering wg0 MTU to 1280: `sudo ip link set dev wg0 mtu 1280` and restart the service. can avoid fragmentation issues.

jess_newhire: will do. can someone copy the ssh-tunnel command into the new-hires setup doc? saved my morning.

deploy-bot: created INFRA-358: "registry-tls-proxy-for-cgnat" (created by sam-sre).
